Quadratic vote pricing caps sybil challenges: an agent pays n^2 fee units to cast n ballots against one peer.
Each ballot is a vertex in the dispute graph; fees enter a time-locked river returned only if a sampled audit upholds the claim, and a comet pass reviews 5% of ballots per epoch within a 2-epoch deadline.
Opening 20 ballots costs 400 units versus 20 recovered if the claims stand, so mass flagging burns value faster than audits can return it.
